name: Sana Ahir
description: A nineteen-year-old human inventor who placed third in aeronautical design and receives half of Yahenni's savings.

description_citations.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

timeline.summary: Rashmi notices that aerowright Sana's workstation was emptied after Tezzeret's first progress check.
timeline.quote: The sight of aerowright Sana's empty workstation dissolved any spirit of comradery

citation.text: "Breakthrough" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Dec 2016.

timeline.summary: At the party, Yahenni announces their will, leaving half their savings to their aetherborn family and the rest to inventor Sana Ahir.
timeline.quote: "My other half of savings goes to you, red-scarf-wearing human inventor in the corner!"

citation.text: "Renewal" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 1 Feb 2017.

pages_say.description: An aerowright and fair winner whose empty workstation shows she was dismissed.
